reference: The chain was rusted through; nevertheless, the bike rolled by noon.
sk: Reťaz bola úplne zhrdzavená; napriek tomu bicykel do obeda jazdil.
cz: Řetěz byl úplně zrezivělý; přesto kolo do oběda jezdilo.
acceptable: The chain was {rusted through|completely rusted|completely rusty}; {nevertheless|nonetheless}, the {bike|bicycle} {rolled|was rolling} by {noon|midday|lunch|lunchtime}.
The chain was {rusted through|completely rusted|completely rusty}; {nevertheless|nonetheless}, the {bike|bicycle} was {working|running} by {noon|lunchtime}.

mistakes.text: The chain was rusted through; {despite|in spite of}, the {bike|bicycle} rolled by noon.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Despite“ a „in spite of“ potrebujú podstatné meno; samostatne na začiatku vety patrí „nevertheless“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Despite“ a „in spite of“ potřebují podstatné jméno; samostatně na začátku věty patří „nevertheless“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Despite” and “in spite of” need a noun after them; as a sentence linker use “nevertheless”.

mistakes.text: The chain was rusted through; {although|even though}, the {bike|bicycle} rolled by noon.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Although“ aj „even though“ uvádzajú vedľajšiu vetu, nestoja samy za bodkočiarkou. Treba „nevertheless“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Although“ i „even though“ uvádějí vedlejší větu, nestojí samy za středníkem. Je potřeba „nevertheless“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Although” and “even though” start a clause and can't stand alone after a semicolon; use “nevertheless”.

mistakes.text: The chain was rusted through; however, the {bike|bicycle} rolled by noon.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „However“ vyjadrí len kontrast; „napriek tomu“ presnejšie zodpovedá „nevertheless“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “However” only contrasts; “nevertheless” better means “in spite of this”.

mistakes.text: The chain was rusted through, but the {bike|bicycle} rolled by noon.
mistakes.feedback_en: Here practise the more formal linker “nevertheless” instead of “but”.

mistakes.text: The chain was rusted through; nevertheless, the {bike|bicycle} rolled until noon.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Until“ znamená „až do“ (dej trval); „do obeda“ ako termín je „by noon“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Until“ znamená „až do“ (děj trval); „do oběda“ jako termín je „by noon“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Until” means the action lasted up to noon; for a deadline use “by noon”.
